name: ODEDentalToDentalReferral
title: ODE Dental-to-Dental Referral
description: A dentist-to-dentist referral. CDT is the working vocabulary and is must-support on the requested service. SNODENT is should-support for diagnostic/clinical granularity — modeled as an optional (non-MS) slice documented as SHOULD, because FHIR has no native should-support flag. No medical codes are required. Supporting imaging uses support-a-pull (receiver retrieves it) — see the Attachments interface, not modeled by this profile.

element.short: SHOULD support — SNODENT diagnostic/clinical detail (optional slice, not MS).
element.comment: Senders SHOULD populate SNODENT when available; receivers MUST NOT reject a referral that omits it. Represented as a non-must-support slice because FHIR's only conformance flag is Must Support.

element.short: MS: clinical note; periodontal charting when perio-relevant. Supporting imaging is referenced elsewhere; the receiver retrieves it via support-a-pull, not in the initial submission.
MS, REQUIRED: the tooth (ode-tooth) — you cannot extract 'a tooth'.
